typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Urgency as string,
		ID as string,
		Status as string,
		Sender_Address as string,
		Country as string,
		Receiver_Address as string,
		MT as string,
		NACK as string,
		Sender_TRN as string,
		Receiver_TRN as string,
		Amount as string,
		CCY as string,
		Work_Type as string,
		Instructions as string,
		GPI as string,
		PXASSIGNEDOPERATORID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(Load_Date = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		Status as string,
		GPI as string,
		Receiver_address as string,
		MT as string,
		Amount as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Instructions as string,
		Sender_TRN as string,
		PXASSIGNEDOPERATORID as string,
		Receiver_TRN as string,
		Sender_address as string,
		CCY as string,
		Country as string,
		Work_type as string,
		ID as string,
		Urgency as string,
		NACK as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		GPI,
		Receiver_address = Receiver_Address,
		MT,
		Amount,
		Load_Date,
		Instructions,
		Sender_TRN,
		PXASSIGNEDOPERATORID,
		Receiver_TRN,
		Sender_address = Sender_Address,
		CCY,
		Country,
		Work_type = Work_Type,
		ID,
		Urgency,
		NACK),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
